scope: Isolated built Go service, memory store and real loopback HTTP chat fixture; no paid upstream or developer database. PostgreSQL durability is tested separately.
checks: real structured multi-turn messages and explicit output budget reach the loopback gateway; private model bindings remain server-side
immutable edit branches, branch-bound pagination, stable conversation keysets, parent isolation, CAS and original-key replay without extra generation
one active run per conversation, partial stop retained and explicit continuation starts one new request using the original partial answer
whole old turns are omitted with an explicit estimate; newest-input overflow is rejected before upstream calls or conversation mutation
conversation audit redaction and fixed route labels omit titles, message text, resource identifiers and provider credentials
